description:
S18 E05 — Wild Animal
In the early hours of the morning, Mallory, a wealthy woman, finds an abandoned baby; she drives the baby to a caravan park and abandons it there to be found by someone else; however, she feels like the child's mother is stalking her.

title: The Island
description:
S01 E01 — Arrivals
A ghost ship carrying a deadly virus runs aground on Sløborn in the North Sea, but the islanders remain unaware of the danger.

title: The Island
description:
S01 E02 — Host
The situation escalates when Evelin fails to abort her unborn child; the boys who discovered and looted the ghost ship spread the virus all over the island without knowing it.

title: Tales From The Void
description:
S01 E04 — Carry
Katie is thrilled when she learns she's pregnant, fulfilling her lifelong dream of becoming a mother; when she learns her unborn child isn't viable, she finds that termination is not in line with her religious community's expectations.

title: The Trouble With Tessa
description:
S01 E04 — Part Four: Heir
Tessa returns to find that someone has taken the tapes; as strange noises rise from the basement, a surprise visit from Betsy changes everything.

title: Heavy Trip
description: A young man is trying to overcome his fears by leading an unknown heavy metal band to the hottest metal festival in Norway. The journey includes heavy metal, grave robbing, Viking heaven, and an armed conflict between Finland and Norway.

title: The Beyond
description: Gruesome deaths occur when a woman (Katherine MacColl) inherits a hotel that is one of seven gateways to hell.

title: Elvira's Movie Macabre
description:
S01 E28 — Legacy of Blood
Three wicked sisters and their equally unsavory husbands arrive at a remote inn where they mean to attend the reading of their uncle's will.
